about: The MCP clients Maidan is tested against and how each one authenticates to it. client_matrix_e2e reads this file. It connects to a real server the way each client does, and checks that docs/Clients.md has each client's recipe. Each row's facts come from the client's own documentation on the date in checked. Re-read them each quarter, and when a client ships a release that changes how it does MCP.

auth_modes.bearer-header: A static Authorization: Bearer header carrying a token minted for the agent. The client sends it on every request.
auth_modes.anonymous-dev: No credential. Only a dev instance with MAIDAN_DEV_ANONYMOUS_MCP_WORKSPACE answers, read-only, on one synthetic workspace.
auth_modes.oauth: OAuth 2.1 sign-in on /mcp/streamable (docs/OAuth.md): the client identifies itself by a client metadata document or a pre-registered client, and the person consents. The flow is proven by the oauth_*_e2e tests, not here.

clients.name: Claude Code
clients.note: With a configured Authorization header, a 401 is a connection failure, not a sign-in prompt.

clients.name: Cursor
clients.note: Its token refresh is unreliable, so a person checks it each release.

clients.name: Gemini CLI
clients.note: httpUrl is Streamable HTTP in every release, and the documentation still calls a plain url the older SSE transport, so use httpUrl. The repository root is also a Gemini CLI extension (gemini-extension.json).

clients.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
clients.note: Form elicitation since 0.0.421 and URL elicitation since 0.0.423.

clients.name: claude.ai custom connector
clients.note: Signs in with OAuth, identified by its client metadata document on claude.ai (MAIDAN_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_HOSTS=claude.ai). Recipe: examples/connect/claude.md.

clients.name: ChatGPT developer mode
clients.note: It takes OAuth or no authentication, and Maidan has no OAuth server, so it reads a dev instance anonymously.
